events.text:
**Recommendation: St. Joseph.** Fish about 120 ft of water with spoons, and run rotators and flies as well. My ratings are below.

| Port | Rating (0-4) | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| St. Joseph | **3 (good)** | Latest report rated "good" |
| Grand Haven | **2 (average)** | Latest report not rated; the week before was rated good |
| South Haven | **2 (average)** | Latest report rated average |
| Muskegon | **2 (average, low end)** | Latest report rated average; the week before was below average |

**What the reports say (newest are 6 days old, from 2023-07-26)**
- **St. Joseph:** "Salmon anglers continued to have good success," rated 3. The most consistent water was about 120 ft. Spoons caught most of the fish, with rotators and flies also catching fish. A few fish came from 30 and 50 ft (St. Joseph, 2023-07-26). The week before was rated 2, with "a few fish" in 100 ft and the fishing "slowing down" (St. Joseph, 2023-07-19).
- **Grand Haven:** The report describes a mixed bag of salmon and trout in 80-140 ft of water. Salmon were 60-120 ft down on orange or green spoons, and yellow or green meat rigs also worked. It had no quality rating (Grand Haven, 2023-07-26). The prior week was rated 3, with fish 65-120 ft down in 130-220 ft of water on yellow and green meat rigs and green flies. Glow spoons produced Chinook in low light (Grand Haven, 2023-07-19).
- **South Haven:** "Decent fishing," rated 2. The best water was around 110 ft, and rotators, flies and meat rigs did best (South Haven, 2023-07-26). The week before was rated 1, and the fish were mostly lake trout with some coho and steelhead (South Haven, 2023-07-19).
- **Muskegon:** The action was "fair," rated 2. The best bite was 60-100 ft down in 90-150 ft of water, on green or glow spoons and green meat rigs (Muskegon, 2023-07-26). The week before was rated 1, "hit or miss" (Muskegon, 2023-07-19).

**Water.** The buoy surface temperature last week was 75 F at St. Joseph, 74 F at South Haven and 72 F at Grand Haven and Muskegon. Those readings are measured. Live conditions were unavailable, so I have no wind forecast and no modeled cold-layer depth. Check the marine forecast before you launch.

**History, same time of year in 2022**
- Early August 2022 was similar. St. Joseph was rated 3 in both weeks (St. Joseph, 2022-08-03 and 2022-08-10).
- Muskegon was rated 3 in both weeks, with salmon 55-130 ft down in 120-250 ft of water and the best bite in low light (Muskegon, 2022-08-03 and 2022-08-10).
- Grand Haven was rated 2, then 3 (Grand Haven, 2022-08-03 and 2022-08-10).
- South Haven was the weakest, rated 1 or unrated (South Haven, 2022-08-03 and 2022-08-10). Its pier was closed for several days because of red-flag conditions (South Haven, 2022-08-10).

**My read**
- I'd expect St. Joseph to stay the best bet, since it was the only port rated good last week and was also good at this point in 2022.
- I'd expect Grand Haven to be equal to or slightly better than Muskegon. Its bite was good the week before last, and last year's Muskegon bite was best in low light. Fishing early or late there would be sensible.
- I'd expect South Haven to be average at best, with lake trout in the mix.
- These ratings are inferences from week-old reports. A shift in wind or water temperature could change them.
